where: copying blaze's pinned LLVM between two ix VMs
what: `ix shell a -- tar -cf - dir | ix shell b -- tar -xf -` through the Mac moved 355 MB in about 20 minutes (0.3 MB/s), and a foreground wait on it is moved to the background after three minutes.
cost: 20 minutes before the first build could start
cause: the bytes go VM to Mac to VM through two interactive shells; there is no VM-to-VM copy and no fetch of the pinned LLVM by its hash on a fresh VM
workaround: started the clone and rustup meanwhile
state: open: a lane's VM should fetch the pinned LLVM itself (`blaze` does, cargo's build of blaze does not)
